highlights: MVP delivery advanced well: 2 of 3 delivery tasks were completed, including the routing contract pass and the inbox acknowledgement flow.
You completed 4 of 5 logged sessions overall, showing strong follow-through despite one interrupted block.
You recovered from the midweek dip by shrinking task size; focus rebounded from 42 on 2026-03-05 to 69 on 2026-03-06.
blockers: Recovery work lagged behind delivery: the sleep trend check is still todo and the missed call review remains blocked.
Meeting-heavy windows interrupted a planned block and lined up with higher tension and slower progress.
Short sleep of 330 minutes pulled energy down late in the week and coincided with elevated fatigue signals.
trends: Focus started strong, dropped midweek during interruptions, and improved again after work was broken into shorter blocks.
Energy stayed below focus for most of the week, suggesting you could still ship delivery work even when recovery was not fully there.
Stress and fatigue markers were highest late in the sprint, then eased after the recovery day as sleep improved to 405 minutes and audio/video signals stabilized.
nextSuggestions: Finish the in-progress prompt review in another short, protected block rather than a longer session.
Unblock the recovery track by turning the sleep trend check into a 10 to 20 minute next step and clarifying what is blocking the missed call review.
Add a recharge break or lighter task after meeting-heavy periods, especially on short-sleep days.
Keep using smaller, explicit tasks because that pattern matched your best rebound in focus this week.
